source: This table is intentionally selective. It shows why the phrase “Transformer block” should trigger a checklist rather than a single memorized drawing: norm placement, branch ordering, attention head structure, positional method, MLP gating, and internal attention modifications can all change.
zh: 这张表是有意选择的。它说明了为什么短语“Transformer block”应该触发一个清单而不是一个记忆的绘图：范数放置、分支排序、注意力头结构、位置方法、MLP 门控和内部注意力修改都可以改变。
